items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I played a little while with Joe Liggins and the Honeydrippers, which wasn't my style, but I knew Frank Passley, and he talked me into it -- him and Happy Prince.

ctx.x: And who was in that band at the time? Do you remember?
Well, they had Alex Hill on piano, Frank Passy(?)...
Oh, yeah, Frank Passley(?). Because we got some of them on yesterday's tape, but I wasn't sure.
